/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, tempfile, os, shutil, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/214_9.pptx')
ns = {
    'p': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main',
    'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'p14': 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main',
    'p15': 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2012/main',
    'mc': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006',
}
for prefix, uri in ns.items():
    ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, dir=str(pptx.parent), suffix='.pptx') as tmp:
    tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)

try:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            data = zin.read(item.filename)
            if item.filename == 'ppt/slides/slide1.xml':
                root = ET.fromstring(data)
                cSld = root.find('p:cSld', ns)
                if cSld is None:
                    raise RuntimeError('slide1.xml has no p:cSld')
                old_bg = cSld.find('p:bg', ns)
                if old_bg is not None:
                    cSld.remove(old_bg)
                bg = ET.Element(f\"{{{ns['p']}}}bg\")
                bgPr = ET.SubElement(bg, f\"{{{ns['p']}}}bgPr\")
                solid = ET.SubElement(bgPr, f\"{{{ns['a']}}}solidFill\")
                ET.SubElement(solid, f\"{{{ns['a']}}}srgbClr\", {'val': '00B050'})
                ET.SubElement(bgPr, f\"{{{ns['a']}}}effectLst\")
                cSld.insert(0, bg)
                data = ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
            zout.writestr(item, data)
    os.replace(tmp_path, pptx)
finally:
    if tmp_path.exists():
        tmp_path.unlink()
print('updated slide 1 background to #00B050')
